units.source_text: “干活，说起来简单……真想让你看看这个村子的姑娘干活的情景。”

en.t: “Work sounds simple enough when you say it... I really wish I could show you how the girls in this village work.”

units.source_text: 千重子又把视线投向杉山，说，

en.t: Chieko turned her gaze back toward Sugiyama and said,

units.source_text: “已经是开始整枝的时候了吧。”

en.t: “It must already be time to start pruning the branches, isn't it?”
